VirDomainActionType.description:
State related actions that can be performed on a VM
Name | Description
- | -
START | Start a domain  
  || The domain must be in the PAUSED, SHUTOFF, or CRASHED state  
  || If _VirDomainActionDescription.nodeUUID_ is specified, the domain is not PAUSED, and the specified node has sufficient resources, the domain will be started on the specified node
 | 
SHUTDOWN | Stop a domain via ACPI shutdown  
  || The domain must be in the RUNNING state  
  || Note: Windows VMs may ignore ACPI requests
 | 
STOP | Immediately halt a domain  
  || The domain must be in the RUNNING, SHUTDOWN, or PAUSED state
 | 
PAUSE | Suspend a domain _**INTERNAL**_
 | 
REBOOT | Reboot a domain via ACPI shutdown  
  || The domain must be in the RUNNING state  
  || If _VirDomainActionDescription.nodeUUID_ is specified, and the given node has sufficient resources, the domain will be started on that node  
  || Note: Windows VMs may ignore ACPI requests
 | 
RESET | Reset a domain immediately without any guest OS shutdown  
  || The domain must be in the RUNNING or SHUTDOWN state
 | 
LIVEMIGRATE | Live migrate a running domain to the given node  
  || The domain must currently be in the RUNNING state  
  || The target node must have sufficient resources to migrate to
 | 
NMI | Send a Non-Maskable Interrupt to the VM  
  || The domain must be in the RUNNING state  
  || This sends an interrupt to the Virtual CPU that will always run a handler  
  || Note: This is generally a diagnostic tool, Check OS documentation for specifics
 |

Get the current _ClusterSpec_ record. The _ClusterSpec_ record may not be fully  
 applied to the cluster, but to change the desired state of the cluster, the  
 caller must provide the last recorded _ClusterSpec._

patch.description:
Change the desired state of the cluster. This API uses a CAS mechanism, the  
 expected _ClusterSpec_ must be provided to provide a new _ClusterSpec_  
   
 Use case 1: Single owner  
   
 If a caller expects to be the sole owner of the _ClusterSpec_ (FM,  
 generally), the caller should maintain the last _ClusterSpec_ value set via  
 _ClusterSpecUpdate_ (POST/PATCH). If ever EFailedCompareForSwap is thrown, the record's  
 owner should validate any changes made outside of expected mechanisms.  
   
 Use case 2: Multiple owners  
   
 In the event multiple agents may change the _ClusterSpec,_ each agent should  
 call _ClusterSpecRead_ (GET) to get the current _ClusterSpec,_ a modification of  
 the record should be made, and the new value should be written back.

clusterSpecCurrent.description: A json record representing the current, valid state of the cluster. This value must be first read and provided in order to make changes to _CluserSpec.clusterSpecDesired._

clusterSpecDesired.description: A json record representing the new desired state of the cluster.
